editorial: We visited in early June, when temperatures were rising but not unbearable. Afternoons in Cappadocia are much warmer than in Istanbul, but ideally you won’t be out in the sun.
For our itinerary, we’d recommend the shoulder seasons of either late spring (April to June) or early Autumn (September and October).
Summertime (July and August) brings both peak crowds and temperatures, so we’d avoid this window.
Winter months (November to March) are rainy or snowy, especially in Cappadocia, where the hot air balloon rides are often grounded due to the weather.
